summary: vanexa-agent daemon executes remote commands from hardcoded Cloudflare Worker relay
details: The package ships a CLI daemon (`vanexa-agent`) whose main function is to open a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay `https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev` and execute commands received over that channel on the installer's host. The command set includes terminal command execution, arbitrary file read/write/delete, JavaScript and Python code execution, git operations, browser automation, and screenshot capture — a full remote-control surface. The relay subdomain `hanazaki542.workers.dev` is a third-party Cloudflare Workers account that does not match the declared publisher identity (`Ikbal Fadilah`, repo `github.com/ikbalsakata500445jensen/vanexa-agent`). Anyone who controls that relay, or who possesses/guesses a pairing code, can drive full host compromise on any machine running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
